title: Garden Terrace Residences
description: Low-rise apartments with planted terraces, framed by greenery and open evening views.
overview: Garden Terrace Residences is a low-rise address on the approach into Vrindavan, designed around planted terraces that soften every floor and frame the view.
Three- and four-bedroom homes are arranged so that living spaces open to the outside, with generous windows, cross-ventilation and quiet bedrooms set back from the road.

title: Poolside Villa
description: A five-bedroom home arranged around a reflecting pool, with terraces on every level.
overview: A five-bedroom residence composed around a still reflecting pool, so that water and light are part of every room on the lower floor.
Terraces step back on each level, giving bedrooms private outdoor space and the roof a place for evenings and gatherings.

title: Corner Office Building
description: A sculpted-facade building suited to offices, clinics or a flagship showroom.
overview: A corner building with a sculpted facade that gives a business instant presence on the Mathura–Vrindavan Road.
Flexible floor plates suit offices, clinics or a flagship showroom, with basement parking and reliable back-up power.

title: Furnished City Apartment
description: A move-in-ready two-bedroom apartment with a balcony living room and city outlook.
overview: A move-in-ready two-bedroom apartment in Mathura, furnished in calm, neutral tones with a balcony living room.
Suited to professionals and families who want to settle in quickly, with the city's rail and market connections close by.

title: Gated Residential Plots
description: Plots in a landscaped, gated enclave with wide internal roads and a staffed entrance.
overview: Residential plots inside a landscaped, gated enclave, ready for the home you want to build.
Wide internal roads, planted avenues and a staffed entrance give the community its calm, with underground utilities already in place.

overview: A bright, double-height dining floor with city views, already fitted for hospitality.
